title: INTERVAL — EHR_LINKAGE table
description: Array of donor records. One element is one donor in the linked-record (Caliber endpoint) data. A blank in the provider's data is written as an empty string; the dictionary's own codes are kept as constants.
$comment: Category files are wired into allOf as each category is converted. JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of rows: the dictionary lists no participant identifier (D010/D011).
